title: [Triggered] checkout order submit failures are above 5%
body:
21.6% of POST /checkout/submit requests failed over the last 5 minutes (threshold 5%).

Error Codes Monitored:
* 460 - 🛑 Client Closed Connection Before Timeout
* 500 - 🔧 Internal Server Error
* 501 - 🚫 Not Implemented
* 502 - 🌐 Bad Gateway
* 503 - ⏳ Service Unavailable
* 504 - ⏰ Gateway Timeout
